title: A year of gains, gone in days

lines: the Nasdaq's one-day drop Thursday — enough to erase its entire gain for all of 2026.
In a single day, the year's gains were gone.
The S&P 500 and the Dow both closed in a correction. (CNBC, Nov. 19-20)

An SEC accounting probe into Nvidia added to the slide.

caption:
Wall Street just handed back a year of gains in days — and it's in your 401(k), your RRSP and your index fund too.

The Nasdaq fell 5.3% on Thursday and went negative for 2026, erasing its entire gain for the year. The S&P 500 and the Dow both dropped into a correction — down at least 10% from their highs (CNBC, Nov. 19-20). What lit it: fears the AI boom is overbuilt, with an SEC accounting probe into Nvidia piling on. Canada didn't escape either — the TSX fell into a correction too (CBC).

My take: a correction isn't a crash, and selling into one is how a paper dip turns into a real loss — the hardest move is usually to do nothing.
